chunks.title: Chest Freezer Common Specs
chunks.content: Both ARCTIC PROFREEZE (PDF) and Inverteron (PDIN) chest freezers use R-600a refrigerant, reach -33°C Extreme Freezing, and have 70mm thick insulation.

chunks.title: ARCTIC Inverteron Specifics
chunks.content: The ARCTIC Inverteron series stands out with a 110V low voltage start and is compatible with 600W-1000VA UPS & Generators.

chunks.title: Twin (Freezer + Fridge) Models
chunks.content: Models containing a 'T' (e.g., PDFT70-155, PDINT70-155) have a total capacity of 410 Liters split physically into two compartments: 261 Liters Freezer and 149 Liters Refrigerator.

chunks.model: PVF INV 6D GD, PVF INV 7D GD, PVF 6D, PVF 7D
chunks.title: Vertical Freezers (PVF Series)
chunks.content: PEL Vertical Freezers feature 80mm insulation and -30°C super freezing. Glass Door (GD) models are Inverter-based, use R600a, and consume 108W. VCM models are Non-Inverter, use R134a, and consume 152W. The 6D models have 239L capacity (6 drawers), while the 7D models have 281L capacity (7 drawers). All have a 10 Years Compressor Warranty.
